description: Exported by Interlinear 0.1.0 from ConsoleHost_history.txt. The steps follow the transcript's line order; each cites its transcript lines and gloss sources.

steps.description: Line 1 (rule; operator): Checks which user the session is running as.
Line 2 (rule; operator): Lists running processes, for example to spot security tools or competing malware.
Line 3 (rule; operator): Downloads PowerShell code and runs it in memory without saving it.
Line 4 (rule; operator): Creates a new local account, often a backdoor login.
Line 5 (rule; operator): Erases the shell command history to hide what was run.
